Accept Decline Out of stock Vendor: Lichtlaerm Audio Ritual | Distortion $229.00 Product variants Default Title - Sold Out - $229.00 Sold Out     Pairs well with The Ritual is a super organic, meaty distortion sound based on the classic Proco RAT, but vastly improved by using highest quality parts, adding an active 2 band Baxandall style tone stack, way more output and a bigger range on the gain control than the original. Features: Lichtlaerm Audio Smart Relay Technology 3 different clipping forms Comp switch to turn the first gain stage into 2 distinct forms of soft clipping overdrive, giving you modern sounds unheard of RAT-style pedals Cut to define the overall feel and tightnessof the distortion 2 band active EQ with fixed mid band Boost switchable to full range, mid and treble focus Gain & volume with insane range and headroom 9V center-negative power supply (27V internally created) Made in Germany Get more details A completely unique feature is the comp switch that adds 2 different clipping diodes to the first gain stage, adding compression, gain and smoothing out the gain structure, bringing you into way more modern areas of sound than you’d ever expect from a RAT! We also included an internal low pass filter that gives you even more control over the sound! For the relaunch, we added our proprietary cut control that gives you full control over the saturation and overall feel of the gain structure: modern and percussive sounds, classic distortion with a good amount of hair and warmth or full on drone sounds that make you want to put on a robe and let your chords ring out for minutes! The independently foot-switchable boost circuit is a vastly improved version of our tried and proven boost from the Altar and gives you up to 35dB of slightly gritty boost that can be used as a full range boost (O))), anyone?), mid boost or a treble boost, which cleans up the low end and adds a lot of nice harmonics. This thing gives you anything from early Darkthrone to Sunn O))) walls of drone, yet is best suited for Neurosis, Isis, Amenra type sounds that have become synonymous with the term Post Metal! Post Metal Distortion is most definitely one of the very best Extended Range Rat style Distortions out there Aug 6, 2024 08:00 by  Stefan Karlsson Distortion Lichtlaerm Audio Rat Style Fuzz Full Article Read Summary Key Points Lichtlaerm Audio’s .Ritual. is an extended range Rat style distortion with active 3-band EQ ±18dB, 3-way Range Boost, sweepable Era control from White Face Rat to Turbo Rat, low-cut, Gain and Level. This edition replaces the usual Comp switch with 3-band EQ and two sweepable mini knobs; existing demos cover the previous edition. It sounds strong at noon and offers extensive shaping. Preferred settings use Turbo, Treble Range, Cut minimum and Boost on. It was the reviewer’s 39th Rat style distortion, with 42 owned. Joe’s Pedals: £179; Lichtlaerm Audio: €199; Eastside Music Supply: $219. So my 4th Lichtlaerm Audio pedal is also my 39th Rat style Distortion - and right up among the very best of that genre. It doesn’t have the multiple clipping options like many of the others do, but it more than makes up for it with its extensive shaping abilities - which include Active 3-Band EQ, a smart 3-way Range Boost, and a sweepable Era control which takes you from a classic White Face Rat voicing to a Turbo Rat Voicing fully clockwise - and with all kind of interesting in-between settings. It’s one of those pedals that sounds totally amazing already with everything at noon - and then you just need to tweak a few of those dials for fully optimal dial-in. Really easy to dial in for me - where it’s strong starting position totally helped with the ease of this pedal’s deployment. This particular edition is slightly different to most of the listed ones - where they have 3 toggle switches in the bottom row, including a Comp switch - while my edition delivers 3-Band EQ - with 2 fully sweepable mini knobs in the bottom row - therefore a further update versus most of the existing online references and demos. Controls - 3-Band Active EQ ±18dB : Bass, Mids, High, Boost (+36dB & Range), Gain, Level, Range (Boost) : Mid / Treble / Full, Era : White Face > Turbo Rat, Low-Cut up to 1.5kHz, Boost Footswitch, Bypass Footswitch. August is going to be something of a Rat Month - where I’m due to do a 32 Compact Favourites run-down fairly soon - and my Rat collection is now up to 42 units - with a couple of those still inbound.
